body:
Vertical integration → ROCE 34%; FY26 CFO 1.6x PAT; but H1 inflow ₹1,638 cr vs ~₹3,800 cr executed, order book shrinking 16.4k→14.2k; DII 15.2%→6.0%.
Kill criteria: FY27 inflow <₹7,000 cr; order book <₹12,000 cr at Mar-27; OPM <11% 2 qtrs; FY27 CFO < PAT
Caveat: sourced from public screens — no proprietary edge (lesson L1). Pledges not confirmed from NSE SAST.
